page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries; running head at top; page number 422 at top left. Below the text nothing else printed except a catchword "Contabescere" is at the foot right as "bescere" continuation line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Lux] Lumen, Lucr. Luminare, Cic. Collyrium oculorum. Revelator omnium.
Luxare membrum] Intorquere talum, Plin. Extorquere articulum, Sen. Convellit bos armum, Col.
Luxatio] Luxum, Cat. Exarticulatio, Cel. Rhod.
Luxatus] Luxus pes, Non. Cat. Eluxatus, Decalemp. ex Plin.
Luxuria] Profusa luxuries. Infolentia, Cicer. Luxus populator opum, Claud. Blandum malum. Mellitum venenum.
Luxuria noxia] Serviet æternum, qui parvo nescient uti, Hor.
Luxuriari] Diffluere luxuriâ, Tac. Mollitia & luxu fluere, Cic. Luxuriant animi rebus plerumque secundis. Mollescunt pectora, Ovid. Indulgere gaudio, Plin. In longinquum mittere cupiditates, Sen.
Luxuriosus] Adolescens luxu perditus, Ter. Luxuriæ immoderatissimæ, Trebel. Effusus in luxum, Tac. Æsopo luxuriosior, Er.
Lynx] Lupus cervarium, Plinius, Sipont. Gesnerus. Chaus, Id.
main_text.head: M.
main_text.p: Macellum] Tabernacarnaria, Varr. Carnarium, Plaut. Macer] Macilentus, Plaut. Ossa atque pellis totus. Exta inspicere in sole etiam vivo licet. Ita pellucet, quasi laterna Punica, Id. Macie peremptus, Liv. Exsuccus, Quint. Emaceratus, Sen. Scutilus. Vescculus, Fest. Vescus; corpore vesco, Plin. Torridus macie, Cic. Ossa pelle amicta lurida, Hor. Vix ossibus hæret, Virg. Monogrammos. Macellus, Non. Male habitus, Gell. Petilus, Varr. Aëre & rore pastus. Tam pinguis, quàm cor.
Macerare] Præmacerare mala, Scribon. Madefacere, Virg. Madidare, Arnob. Imbuere liquoribus. Sinere aliquid in aqua, Col. Vid. Emaciare.
Macere] Macescere, Plaut. Extabescere macie. Contabescere

page.notes: Catchword at foot right reads "bescere", completing "Contabescere". Some words in the lower half are faint; "Vescculus" and "Monogrammos" read as printed.
